package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"os"
	"regexp"
	"regexp/syntax"
	"runtime"
	"strconv"
	"strings"
)

func main() {
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "admission" {
		admission()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "classes" {
		classes()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "ranges" {
		ranges()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "names" {
		names()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "flags" {
		flags()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "unicode" {
		unicodeClasses()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "erased" {
		erasedCaptures()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "nested" {
		nestedRepetitions()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "selector-names" {
		selectorNames()
		return
	}
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "scalar-complements" {
		scalarComplements()
		return
	}
	cases := []map[string]any{}
	for _, p := range []string{`^\w$`, `(?i)^\w$`, `(?i)^\W$`, `^[\W]$`, `(?i)^[\W]$`, `^\s$`, `^[\S]$`, `^\v$`, `\bfoo\b`, `^.$`, `[\W^a]`, `[^\W^a]`, `[\W^]`, `[^\W^]`, `[a\W-z]`, `^a}*$`, `^\{2}*$`} {
		for _, v := range []string{"a", "é", "٣", "ſ", "K", "\v", "a\n", "éfooé", "^", "b", "c", "a}}", "{2}}"} {
			cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"pattern": p, "value": v, "match": regexp.MustCompile(p).MatchString(v)})
		}
	}
	// Keep the original 221 answers unchanged. Braced hex escapes are atoms,
	// not counted repetitions; real following repetitions still bind to them.
	for _, p := range []string{
		`[\x{41}-\x7a]\x61`, // Complete Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go:124 pattern.
		`^\x{61}+$`, `^\x{61}*$`, `^\x{61}?$`, `^\x{61}{2}$`,
		`^\x{61}{2,3}?$`, `^\x{000061}{2}$`, `(?i)^\x{c9}{2}$`,
		`^\x{100}{0,1}$`, `^\x{0}{2}$`, `^\x{10}{2}$`, `^\x{7b}+$`,
		`^\x{5b}{2}$`, `^\x{61}{2}\x{62}+$`, `^\x{61}{2}[\x{62}]{2}$`,
		`^\\x{2}$`, `^\\x{2}a+$`,
		`^\x{61}??$`, `^\x{61}{2}?$`,
	} {
		for _, v := range []string{"", "a", "aa", "aaa", "aaaa", "ab", "aab", "aabb", "éé", "Éé", "Ā", "\x00\x00", "\x10\x10", "{{", "[[", `\xx`, `\xxaa`, `\x{61}`, "Aa", "za", "{a"} {
			cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"pattern": p, "value": v, "match": regexp.MustCompile(p).MatchString(v)})
		}
	}
	// The five complete quoted-literal rows at Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go:
	// 152-156 and the complete octal row at 123. Private AST expectations are
	// not matching oracles; execute both substring and whole-label matching.
	for _, p := range []string{
		`\Q+|*?{[\E`, `\Q+\E+`, `\Qab\E+`, `\Q\\E`, `\Q\\\E`,
		`[\012-\234]\141`,
		`\Q\d\E`, `\Qa.b`, `\Q`, `a\Q\E+`, `\Q\Eab`,
		`(?i)\Qé.\E+`, `\Q(?P<fake>x)[\d]{2}\E`,
		`\Qabc\Qdef\E`, `\Q[\E[ab]+`, `\Q\\E+`,
		`\0`, `\00`, `\000`, `\12`, `\141+`, `\400{2}`, `\777`,
		`\1234`, `\078`, `[\0-\07]`, `[\141-\143]+`,
		`(?i)\153`, `(?P<got>\141+)`, `\\141`,
	} {
		re := regexp.MustCompile(p)
		tree, err := syntax.Parse(p, syntax.Perl|syntax.DotNL)
		if err != nil {
			panic(err)
		}
		full := regexp.MustCompile(`\A(?:` + tree.String() + `)\z`)
		for _, v := range []string{
			"", "a", "aa", "ab", "abb", "abab", "a.b", "axb", `\d`, `\`, `\\`,
			"+|*?{[", "+", "++", "É..", "é.", "é.é.", "(?P<fake>x)[\\d]{2}",
			`abc\Qdef`, "[ab", "[x", "\x00", "\x00\x00", "\a", "\n", "\na",
			"a\n", "\u009ca", "Ā", "ĀĀ", "ǿ", "S4", "\a8", "abc", "k", "K", `\141`, "prefixabsuffix",
		} {
			cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"pattern": p, "value": v, "match": re.MatchString(v), "label_match": full.MatchString(v)})
		}
	}
	// Local controls for POSIX classes and their folded complements. PCRE's
	// named classes do not independently provide Go's simple Unicode folding.
	for _, name := range []string{"alnum", "alpha", "ascii", "blank", "cntrl", "digit", "graph", "lower", "print", "punct", "space", "upper", "word", "xdigit"} {
		for _, prefix := range []string{"", "(?i)"} {
			for _, body := range []string{"[[:" + name + ":]]", "[[:^" + name + ":]]", "[^[:" + name + ":]]", "[^[:^" + name + ":]]"} {
				p := prefix + "^" + body + "$"
				re := regexp.MustCompile(p)
				for _, v := range []string{"", "a", "A", "k", "s", "K", "ſ", "é", "٣", "0", "_", "\t", "\v", "\n", "\x00", "^", "-"} {
					cases = append(cases, map[string]any{"pattern": p, "value": v, "match": re.MatchString(v)})
				}
			}
		}
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(cases)
}

type input struct {
	text   string
	repeat int
}

var admissionInputs = []input{
	{"", 1}, {"x", 1}, {"x", 2}, {"x", 998}, {"x", 999}, {"x", 1000}, {"x", 1001},
	{"y", 500}, {"x{1001", 1}, {"x{1001}", 1}, {"x{0001}", 1}, {"x{01,2}", 1},
	{"x{1,02}", 1}, {"x{0000}", 1}, {"x{01", 1}, {"x{,1001}", 1}, {"x{1001a}", 1},
	{"x{1,,2}", 1}, {"x{1,2,3}", 1}, {"x{1,a}", 1}, {"x{1, 2}", 1}, {"x{1,2", 1},
	{"x{}", 1}, {"x{{", 1}, {"{1001}", 1}, {"éx", 1}, {"[x{1001}]", 1},
}

func admission() {
	// Complete Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go patterns at 44, 480-483,
	// 501-503, followed by local boundary, literal-brace and scope controls.
	compileCases([]string{
		`x{1001`, `x{1001}`, `x{9876543210}`, `x{2,1}`, `x{1,9876543210}`,
		`a{100000}`, `a{100000,}`, `((((((((((x{2}){2}){2}){2}){2}){2}){2}){2}){2}){2})`,
		`x{999}`, `x{1000}`, `x{1000,}`, `x{0,1000}`, `x{0,1001}`, `x{1001,}`,
		`(x{100}){10}`, `(x{100}){11}`, `(x{1001}){0}`, `(x{1000}){0}`,
		`((x{1000}){0}){1000}`, `(x{1000}|y{500}){1}`, `(x{1000}|y{500}){2}`,
		`(x{100})*`, `(x{100})+`, `(x{100})?`, `x{0}`, `x{1,}`,
		`x{0001}`, `x{01,2}`, `x{1,02}`, `x{0000}`, `x{01`, `x{,1001}`,
		`x{1001a}`, `x{1,,2}`, `x{1,2,3}`, `x{1,a}`, `x{1, 2}`, `x{1,2`, `x{}`, `x{{2}`,
		`x{99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999a}`,
		`x{99999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999999}`,
		`\Qx{1001}\E`, `\Qx{1001}`, `[x{1001}]`, `\x{78}{1000}`, `\170{1000}`,
		`\{1001}`, `\p{Latin}{2}`, `(x{1000}){0,}`, `((x{1000}){0}|(y{1000}){0}){1000}`,
		`(((x{1000}){0}){1000}){2}`, `(((x{1000}){0}){1}){1000}`,
	}, admissionInputs)
}

func classes() {
	// Local controls: Go treats && and ~~ as ordinary class members, not
	// Rust intersection/symmetric-difference operators. Preserve range rules.
	compileCases([]string{
		`[x&&y]`, `[x~~y]`, `[&&x]`, `[~~x]`, `[^x&&y]`, `[^x~~y]`,
		`[]x&&y]`, `[^]x~~y]`, `[x&&y]{2}`, `(?i)[k&&x]`,
		`[&-~]`, `[&&-x]`, `[&-&]`, `[~-~]`, `[a-&&]`, `[~~-x]`,
		`[\&&]`, `[\~~~]`, `[x&&[:alpha:]]`, `[[:alpha:]&&x]`,
		`[[:^alpha:]&&x]`, `(?i)[[:^alpha:]&&k]`, `[x~~\d]`,
		`[\x{26}&&x]`, `[\046&&x]`, `\Q[x&&y]\E`,
		`[x&&y]&&[x~~y]`, `&&`, `~~`, `x&&y`, `[a--b]`, `[x&&y]+`,
	}, append(admissionInputs, []input{
		{"&", 1}, {"&", 2}, {"~", 1}, {"~", 2}, {"]", 1}, {"a", 1},
		{"k", 1}, {"K", 1}, {"K", 1}, {"ſ", 1}, {"é", 1}, {"1", 1},
		{"[x&&y]", 1}, {"x&y", 1}, {"xy", 1}, {"y&x", 1}, {"[", 1},
		{"x~~y", 1}, {" ", 1}, {"\n", 1},
	}...))
}

func ranges() {
	// Local controls for Go's literal opening brackets and left-to-right
	// ranges. There is no nested-class or set-difference operator in Go.
	compileCases([]string{
		`[[]`, `[a[]`, `[a[]\d`, `[a[:b]]`, `[[:b]]`, `[[a-z]]`,
		`[^[]`, `[]a[]`, `[^]a[]`, `[[-a]`, `[[-[]`, `[a-[]`,
		`[[]\Qx`, `[a[]\Qx`, `[[]\Qx\E+`, `(?i)[k[]`,
		`[[:alpha:][x]`, `[[:^alpha:][x]`, `[[:bogus:]]`, `[[:]]`,
		`[[:]`, `[[.a.]]`, `[[=a=]]`, `[[]|[x]`, `[[]+`, `[[]{2}`,
		`[--]`, `[--x]`, `[---]`, `[----]`, `[-----]`, `[a--]`,
		`[a---]`, `[a-b--x]`, `[a-b-c]`, `[a-b-]`, `[-a]`, `[a-]`,
		`[\--x]`, `[\x{2d}-x]`, `[\055-x]`, `[--\x{78}]`,
		`[--\170]`, `[^--x]`, `[]--x]`, `[[:digit:]--x]`,
		`[\d--x]`, `[a-\d]`, `[a-[:digit:]]`, `[\d-[]`,
		`[&&--x]`, `[~~--x]`, `[[]&&[--x]`, `[x{1001}[]`,
		`[[](`, `[[](?u)x`, `[[]a{1001}`, `[[]\Q`,
		`[a[:]`, `[:alpha:]`, `[a][:alpha:]]`, `[a-\x7a--x]`,
		`[a-\172--x]`, `[\p{Latin}--x]`,
		`[--\d]`, `[--\W]`, `[[-\d]`, `[a-\pL]`, `[a-\p{Latin}]`,
		`[--[:alpha:]]`, `[[-[:^alpha:]]`, `[^--[:alpha:]]`,
	}, append(admissionInputs, []input{
		{"[", 1}, {"[", 2}, {"]", 1}, {"-", 1}, {"-", 2},
		{".", 1}, {"/", 1}, {"0", 1}, {"5", 1}, {"A", 1},
		{"Z", 1}, {"a", 1}, {"b", 1}, {"k", 1}, {"K", 1},
		{"K", 1}, {"ſ", 1}, {"é", 1}, {"&", 1}, {"~", 1},
		{"\\", 1}, {"^", 1}, {"`", 1}, {":", 1}, {"[5", 1},
		{"a5", 1}, {"b]", 1}, {"[]", 1}, {"[x", 1}, {"[xx", 1},
		{"[a]", 1}, {" ", 1}, {"\n", 1}, {"x\n", 1},
	}...))
}

func names() {
	// The first two complete patterns are Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go
	// rows 169-170. Matching answers are executed by Go, not its private ASTs.
	// Other patterns are local admission and quote/class-boundary controls.
	// Numeric/repeated Go names remain outside this increment's acceptance.
	compileCases([]string{
		`(?P<name>a)`, `(?<name>a)`, `(?P<x>x)`, `(?<_x>x)`, `(?P<X_1>x)`,
		`(?P<é>x)`, `(?<é>x)`, `(?P<名>x)`, `(?<a名>x)`, `(?P<K>x)`,
		`(?P<x.y>x)`, `(?<x-y>x)`, `(?P<x[0]>x)`, `(?<x:y>x)`,
		`(?P<>x)`, `(?<>x)`, `(?P< x>x)`, `(?<x >x)`, `(?P<x`,
		`(?P<\Qx\E>x)`, `(?<\170>x)`, `(?P<x\Q\E>x)`, `(?<x\Q\Ey>x)`,
		`(?P<\x78>x)`, `(?<x\Q>y\E>x)`, `[[](?<é>x)`,
		`\Q(?P<é>x)\E`, `\Q(?<é>x)`, `\Q(?P<\170>x)\E`,
		`[(?P<é>x)]`, `(?P<x>\Q(?<é>x)\E)`, `(?P<x>[[]\Qy)`,
		`(?P<x>[--x])`, `(?<x>[a[]\d)`, `(?P<x>x){2}`, `(?i)(?<x>x)`,
		`(?\Qi\E:x)`, `(?\151:x)`, `(?P\Q<x>\Ex)`, `(?\QP<x>\Ex)`,
		`(?\Q:\Ex)`, `(?i\Q\E:x)`, `\Q(?\151:x)\E`, `[(?\151:x)]`,
	}, append(admissionInputs, []input{
		{"a", 1}, {"X", 1}, {"[", 1}, {"é", 1}, {"名", 1},
		{"(?P<é>x)", 1}, {"(?<é>x)", 1}, {`(?P<\170>x)`, 1},
		{"[y)", 1}, {"[5", 1}, {"a5", 1}, {"-", 1},
	}...))
}

func flags() {
	// Complete Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go:193 pattern, then local
	// controls for the parsePerlFlags contract. Execute Go's matcher, not
	// private AST expectations. Empty directives do not create an atom.
	compileCases([]string{
		`(?-s).`, `(?)`, `(?)x`, `x(?)*`, `(?)*`, `(?ii)x`,
		`(?imim)x`, `(?i-i)x`, `(?-ii)x`, `(?i-msm)x`,
		`(?ss).`, `(?mm)^x$`, `(?UU)x+`, `(?U-U)x+`,
		`(?ii:x)X`, `(?i-i:x)X`, `(?ii)x(?-ii)y`,
		`(?mi-mi)^x.$`, `(?ss:.)`, `(?s-s:.)`,
		`x(?ii){2}`, `x(?i-i)*`, `(?ii)*`, `(?i-:)x`,
		`(?-)x`, `(?i--)x`, `(?i--i:x)`, `(?-:x)`, `(?i-i-i:x)`, `(?)(`,
		`\Q(?ii:x)\E`, `[(?ii:x)]`, `[[](?ii:x)`, `(?P<x>(?ii:x))`,
		`(?i-i)K`, `(?ii)k`, `(?ii)[[:lower:]]`, `(?i-i)[[:lower:]]`,
		`(?ii:x(?-ii:y))X`, `(?ii)x|y`, `x(?)(?)?`, `(?)(?ii)x`,
		`(?ii`, `(?i-ix:x)`, `(?i-\Qi\E:x)`, `(?\151i:x)`,
		`(?UU)(?P<piece>x+)(x*)`, `(?U-U)(?P<piece>x+)(x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x(?U)+)(x*)`, `(?U:(?P<piece>x(?-U)+)(x*))`,
		`(?P<piece>x(?U)(?i)+?)(x*)`, `(?U:x)(?P<piece>x(?i)+)(x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x(?ii)+)(x*)`, `x(?i)(?s){2}`, `x(?U){2,3}?x*`,
		`x(?i){1001}`, `x(?i){01}`, `(?i)?`,
	}, append(admissionInputs, []input{
		{"X", 1}, {"xx", 1}, {"xX", 1}, {"XX", 1}, {"xy", 1},
		{"Xy", 1}, {"XY", 1}, {"xY", 1}, {"x\ny", 1}, {"\nx\n", 1},
		{"\n", 1}, {"a", 1}, {"k", 1}, {"K", 1}, {"K", 1},
		{"(?ii:x)", 1}, {"[x", 1},
	}...), true)
}

func unicodeClasses() {
	// The first nine complete patterns are Go 1.27.3 syntax/parse_test.go:
	// 99-107. Matching answers execute Go, not the private AST expectations.
	// Other patterns/inputs are local negation and token-boundary controls.
	compileCases([]string{
		`\p{Braille}`, `\P{Braille}`, `\p{^Braille}`, `\P{^Braille}`, `\pZ`,
		`[\p{Braille}]`, `[\P{Braille}]`, `[\p{^Braille}]`, `[\P{^Braille}]`,
		`\p{^Latin}`, `\P{^Latin}`, `\p{^Greek}`, `\P{^Greek}`,
		`\p{^Lu}`, `\P{^Lu}`, `\p{^Any}`, `\P{^Any}`,
		`[^\p{^Latin}]`, `[^\P{^Latin}]`, `[x\p{^Greek}]`, `[\P{^Greek}\d]`,
		`\p{^Latin}{2}`, `\P{^Latin}{2}`, `(?i)\p{^Lu}`, `(?i)\P{^Lu}`,
		`\Q\p{^Latin}\E`, `[\x{5e}\P{^Greek}]`, `\\p{^Latin}`,
		`(?P<letter>\P{^Latin}+)`,
		`\p{^}`, `\P{^}`, `\p{^^Latin}`, `\P{^^Latin}`, `\p{^NotAScript}`,
		`\P{^Latin`, `[a-\p{^Latin}]`, `[\p{^Latin}-a]`,
	}, append(admissionInputs, []input{
		{"\u27ff", 1}, {"\u2800", 1}, {"\u28ff", 1}, {"\u2900", 1},
		{"α", 1}, {"Α", 1}, {"A", 1}, {"a", 1}, {"K", 1}, {"ſ", 1},
		{"é", 1}, {"αα", 1}, {"aa", 1}, {"\u00a0", 1}, {"\n", 1},
		{"\x00", 1}, {"🙂", 1}, {`\p{^Latin}`, 1}, {"^", 1},
		{"X", 1}, {"xX", 1}, {"XX", 1}, {"xy", 1}, {"xY", 1}, {"k", 1}, {"[x", 1},
	}...), true)
}

func erasedCaptures() {
	// First four: complete zero-repetition patterns in Go 1.27.3
	// regexp/all_test.go:232-235. Other patterns/inputs are local controls.
	compileCases([]string{
		`(a)(b){0}(c)`, `(a)(((b))){0}c`,
		`((a(b){0}){3}){5}(h)`, `((a(b){0}){3}){5}h`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0}`, `(?P<gone>x){0,0}`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0}(?P<later>y){0}`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0}(?P<kept>c)`,
		`(?P<first>a)(?P<gone>b){0}(?P<last>c)`,
		`(?P<gone>(?P<inner>x)){0}(?P<tail>c)`,
		`(?P<outer>(?P<inner>x){0})(?P<tail>c)`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0}|(?P<later>c)`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0}(?P<kept>y)?`,
		`(?P<gone>x){0,1}(?P<kept>c)`,
		`(?P<gone>[^\s\S])?`, `(?P<gone>[^\s\S])*`,
		`(?P<gone>[^\s\S])|(?P<kept>ac)`,
		`(?P<outer>(?P<gone>[^\p{Any}]))?`,
		`(?P<gone>[^\s\S])(?P<also>x)|(?P<kept>y)`,
		`(?P<kept>a)(?P<gone>z[^\s\S])?|(?P<tail>c)`,
		`\Q(?P<fake>x)\E(?P<gone>y){0}(?P<live>c)`,
		`[](?P<fake>)](?P<gone>x){0}(?P<kept>c)`,
		`[[:alpha:](?P<fake>)](?P<gone>x){0}(?P<kept>c)`,
		`(?P<first>a)\Q(?P<fake>x){0}\E(?P<last>c)`,
		`(?:(?P<gone>é){0})(?P<kept>🙂)`,
		`(?P<first>a)(?P<gone>b){0}`, `(a)(b){0}`,
		`(?<gone>x){0}(?<kept>c)`,
	}, []input{
		{"", 1}, {"x", 1}, {"y", 1}, {"c", 1}, {"a", 1}, {"ac", 1},
		{"abc", 1}, {"xc", 1}, {"yc", 1}, {"xacxacx", 1},
		{"say aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah", 1}, {"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaah", 1},
		{"h", 1}, {"é", 1}, {"🙂", 1}, {"é🙂", 1}, {"\n", 1},
		{"(?P<fake>x)c", 1}, {"a(?P<fake>x){0}c", 1}, {"(c", 1}, {"λ", 1},
	}, true)
}

func nestedRepetitions() {
	// Local controls for syntax/parse.go's repeat/parsePerlFlags contract:
	// directives reset lastRepeat without introducing an atom. Execute both
	// matching modes and capture maps; these are not upstream test-table rows.
	compileCases([]string{
		`x*(?)?`, `x+(?i)*`, `x?(?s)+`, `x{2}(?i){3}`,
		`ax*(?)?b`, `ab{2}(?i){2}c`, `x*(?i)?Y`,
		`x(?i)*(?s)?Y`, `x(?U)*(?i)?Y`, `x(?i)*(?-i)?Y`,
		`x*(?i)(?s)?Y`, `x*(?)(?U)??`, `x*(?i){01}`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?)?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*?(?)?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?)??)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x(?U)*(?i)?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?U)?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?U)??)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?U)?(?-U)+)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?U:(?P<piece>x*(?-U)?)(?P<tail>x*))`,
		`(?U:(?P<piece>x*(?-U)??)(?P<tail>x*))`,
		`(?P<piece>x{1,2}(?U){1,2}?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>x*(?)?)*`, `(?P<piece>x{0}(?i){0})(?P<tail>y)`,
		`(?P<piece>(?P<inner>x)+(?i)?)(?P<tail>Y)`,
		`(?P<piece>(x|xy)+(?s)?)(?P<tail>y*)`,
		`a(x*(?i)?b)+(?s)?Y`, `(?P<piece>é+(?i)?)(?P<tail>Y)`,
		`\Qab\E*(?)?`, `\Q*\E+(?i)?`, `\x{78}+(?i)?`, `\170+(?i)?`,
		`[x[]+(?i)?`, `[[:alpha:]]+(?i)?`, `\p{^Latin}+(?i)?`,
		`\Qx*(?)?\E`, `[x*(?)?]`, `x\*(?i)?`, `x(?:)(?i)*`,
		`x{100}(?i){10}`, `x{100}(?i){11}`, `x{1001}(?i){0}`,
		`x{1000}(?i){0}`, `x{1000}(?i){0,}`, `x{0}(?i){1000}`,
		`x*(?)?(?)?(?)?`, `x*(?i)?(?s)?(?-i)?Y`,
		`x**`, `x*?+`, `x*(?i)?+`, `x*(?i)???`, `x*(?i){2}+`,
		`*(?i)?`, `(?i)*`, `x*(?i--s)?`, `x*(?i){2,1}`,
	}, []input{
		{"", 1}, {"x", 1}, {"x", 2}, {"x", 3}, {"x", 4}, {"x", 1000},
		{"X", 1}, {"xX", 1}, {"ab", 1}, {"axb", 1}, {"axxb", 1},
		{"abbbbc", 1}, {"abbbc", 1}, {"abbbbC", 1}, {"aabbbbc", 1},
		{"xy", 1}, {"xY", 1}, {"Xy", 1}, {"Y", 1}, {"y", 1},
		{"ééY", 1}, {"ééy", 1}, {"Ééy", 1}, {"ααY", 1}, {"\n", 1},
		{"*", 1}, {"x*", 1}, {"x*(?)?", 1}, {"[", 1}, {"x{01}", 1},
		{"x", 999}, {"x", 1001}, {"y", 500},
		{"x{0001}", 1}, {"x{1001", 1}, {"x{,1001}", 1},
		{"XX", 1}, {"k", 1}, {"K", 1}, {"[x", 1},
	}, true, true)
}

// Local controls for Go's capture schema and ExpandString contract. The
// repeated-name patterns include the pattern shared by five replacement rows
// at regexp/all_test.go:218-222 and the SubexpNames pattern at line 455.
func selectorNames() {
	patterns := []string{
		`(?P<x>hi)|(?P<x>bye)`, `(?P<foo>.*)(?P<bar>(a)b)(?P<foo>.*)a`,
		`(?P<1>x)`, `(?<1x>x)`, `(?P<0>x)(y)`, `(x)(?P<1>y)`,
		`(?P<01>x)(y)`, `(?<000>x)`, `(?P<999999999>x)`, `(?P<1000000000>x)`,
		`(?P<x>x)|(?P<x>y)`, `(?<x>x)(?<x>y)`, `(?P<x>x)?(?<x>y)`,
		`(?P<x>)(?P<x>x)`, `(?P<x>x){0}(?P<x>y)`,
		`(?P<x>[^\s\S])|(?P<x>x)`, `(?P<x>(?P<x>x))`,
		`(?P<1>x)|(?<1>y)`, `(?P<01>x)|(?<01>y)`,
		`(?P<1>x)(?P<_1>y)`, `(?P<_1>x)(?P<1>y)`,
		`(?P<1>x){0}(?P<_1>y)`, `(?P<0>x){0}(?P<01>y)`,
		`(?P<1x>x*(?i)?)(?P<tail>y)`, `(?P<x>x*(?)?)(?P<x>y)`,
		`\Q(?P<1>x)\E`, `[(?P<1>x)]`, `(?P<1>\Q(?<x>x)\E)`,
		`(?P<>x)`, `(?<1-x>x)`, `(?P<é>x)`, `(?P<\061>x)`,
		`(?P<x>x)(?P<x`, `(?P<1>x){1001}`, `(?P<x>x)(?P<x>y)**`,
	}
	inputs := []string{
		"", "x", "xx", "xxx", "y", "xy", "Xy", "xY", "a", "b", "ab", "aba", "hi", "bye",
		"x{0001}", "x{1001", "x{,1001}", "(?P<1>x)", "(?<x>x)", "\n", "é",
		strings.Repeat("x", 999), strings.Repeat("x", 1000), strings.Repeat("x", 1001), strings.Repeat("y", 500),
	}
	const replacement = `<$0:$1:$2:${x}:${foo}:${bar}:${1x}:${01}:${000}:${999999999}:${1000000000}:$$>`
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, pattern := range patterns {
		re, err := regexp.Compile(pattern)
		row := map[string]any{"pattern": pattern, "valid": err == nil}
		if err == nil {
			// PCRE's name admission differs. Remove names from the Go AST,
			// preserving numeric groups, for independent Boolean matching.
			tree, _ := syntax.Parse(pattern, syntax.Perl)
			var clearNames func(*syntax.Regexp)
			clearNames = func(node *syntax.Regexp) {
				node.Name = ""
				for _, child := range node.Sub {
					clearNames(child)
				}
			}
			clearNames(tree)
			row["reference_pattern"] = tree.String()
			full := regexp.MustCompile(`(?s:\A(?:` + pattern + `)\z)`)
			// Source-derived Loki NewRegexpParser/sanitizeLabelKey rules, not
			// additional Go regexp or upstream engine-table expectations.
			seen := map[string]bool{}
			parserValid := false
			for _, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
				if name != "" {
					parserValid = true
					if seen[name] {
						parserValid = false
						break
					}
					seen[name] = true
				}
			}
			row["parser_valid"] = parserValid
			values := []map[string]any{}
			for _, text := range inputs {
				value := map[string]any{"text": text, "repeat": 1, "match": re.MatchString(text), "label_match": full.MatchString(text)}
				var captures map[string]string
				var expanded any
				if match := full.FindStringSubmatchIndex(text); match != nil {
					captures = map[string]string{}
					for index, name := range full.SubexpNames() {
						key := strconv.Itoa(index)
						captures[key] = string(full.ExpandString(nil, "${"+key+"}", text, match))
						// Decimal aliases below one billion are always indices,
						// even when their declared name has another position.
						n, e := strconv.ParseUint(name, 10, 64)
						numeric := e == nil && n < 1e9 && (len(name) == 1 || name[0] != '0')
						if name != "" && !numeric {
							captures[name] = string(full.ExpandString(nil, "${"+name+"}", text, match))
						}
					}
					expanded = string(full.ExpandString(nil, replacement, text, match))
				}
				value["captures"] = captures
				value["expanded"] = expanded
				if parserValid {
					var named map[string]string
					if match := re.FindStringSubmatch(text); match != nil {
						named = map[string]string{}
						for index, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
							if name == "" {
								continue
							}
							if name[0] >= '0' && name[0] <= '9' {
								name = "_" + name
							}
							if _, exists := named[name]; !exists {
								named[name] = match[index]
							}
						}
					}
					value["named_captures"] = named
				}
				values = append(values, value)
			}
			row["values"] = values
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"go": runtime.Version(), "replacement": replacement, "cases": rows})
}

// Local executed controls, not copied upstream integration-table rows. Go
// permits surrogate code points in regex syntax, but inputs here are UTF-8.
func scalarComplements() {
	patterns := []string{}
	for _, body := range []string{
		`\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`, `\x{e000}\x{d7ff}`,
		"\uD7FF\uE000", "\uE000\uD7FF",
		"\uD7FF" + `\x{e000}`, `\x{d7ff}` + "\uE000",
		`\x{0000D7FF}\x{0000E000}`,
		`\x{d7fe}-\x{d7ff}\x{e000}-\x{e001}`,
		`\x{d7ff}-\x{e000}`, `\x{d7fe}-\x{e001}`,
		`\x{d7ff}`, `\x{e000}`, `\x{d7fe}\x{e001}`,
		`]\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`, `[\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`,
		`\x{d7ff}\x{e000}-`, `\x{d7ff}\x{e000}\-`,
		`[:alpha:]\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`, `\d\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`,
		`\D\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`, `\p{ASCII}\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`,
	} {
		for _, flags := range []string{"", "(?i)"} {
			for _, sign := range []string{"", "^"} {
				patterns = append(patterns, flags+"["+sign+body+"]")
			}
		}
	}
	patterns = append(patterns,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]+`, `[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]{2}`,
		`(?P<piece>[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]+)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]+(?i)?)(?P<tail>x*)`,
		`(?P<piece>[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]){0}(?P<tail>x)`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}][^\x{e000}]`, `[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}][^x]`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}][^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]`,
		`\Q[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]\E`, `[^\\x{d7ff}\\x{e000}]`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}\x{e000}-\x{d7ff}]`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}a--b]`, `[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}\x{zz}]`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}\Qx\E]`, `[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}`,
	)
	inputs := []input{}
	for _, text := range []string{
		"", "x", "X", "K", "α", "\uA7CE", "\uA7CF", "\U00016EA0", "\U00016EBB",
		"\U00011DB0", "\u0378", "XxX", "\u0345", "\u0399",
		"\uD7FE", "\uD7FF", "\uE000", "\uE001", "\uE002", "\U0010FFFF",
		"\uD7FF\uE000", "\uE000\uD7FF", "\uD7FE\uE001", "x\uD7FFx", "x\uE000x",
		"xx", "1", "\n", "\x00", "]", "[", "-", `\x{d7ff}`,
		`[^\x{d7ff}\x{e000}]`,
	} {
		inputs = append(inputs, input{text, 1})
	}
	compileCases(patterns, inputs, true, true)
}

func compileCases(patterns []string, inputs []input, canonicalReference ...bool) {
	rows := []map[string]any{}
	for _, p := range patterns {
		re, err := regexp.Compile(p)
		row := map[string]any{"pattern": p, "valid": err == nil}
		if err == nil {
			if len(canonicalReference) > 0 && canonicalReference[0] {
				// PCRE disallows quantifiers immediately after directives.
				// Go's printed AST preserves their actual atom binding.
				tree, err := syntax.Parse(p, syntax.Perl)
				if err != nil {
					panic(err)
				}
				row["reference_pattern"] = tree.String()
				names := []string{}
				for _, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
					if name != "" {
						names = append(names, name)
					}
				}
				row["capture_names"] = names
			}
			tree, err := syntax.Parse(p, syntax.Perl|syntax.DotNL)
			if err != nil {
				panic(err)
			}
			full := regexp.MustCompile(`\A(?:` + tree.String() + `)\z`)
			values := []map[string]any{}
			for _, input := range inputs {
				v := strings.Repeat(input.text, input.repeat)
				value := map[string]any{"text": input.text, "repeat": input.repeat, "match": re.MatchString(v), "label_match": full.MatchString(v)}
				if len(canonicalReference) > 1 && canonicalReference[1] {
					const replacement = `<$0:${piece}:${tail}>`
					value["count"] = len(re.FindAllStringIndex(v, -1))
					value["replacement"] = re.ReplaceAllString(v, replacement)
					value["literal_replacement"] = re.ReplaceAllLiteralString(v, replacement)
				}
				if len(canonicalReference) > 0 && canonicalReference[0] {
					var captures map[string]string
					if matched := full.FindStringSubmatch(v); matched != nil {
						captures = map[string]string{}
						for index, name := range full.SubexpNames() {
							captures[strconv.Itoa(index)] = matched[index]
							if name != "" {
								captures[name] = matched[index]
							}
						}
					}
					value["captures"] = captures
					var named map[string]string
					if matched := re.FindStringSubmatch(v); matched != nil {
						named = map[string]string{}
						for index, name := range re.SubexpNames() {
							if name != "" {
								named[name] = matched[index]
							}
						}
					}
					value["named_captures"] = named
				}
				values = append(values, value)
			}
			row["values"] = values
		}
		rows = append(rows, row)
	}
	json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{"go": runtime.Version(), "cases": rows})
}
